title: Journal draft packet
description: The only format Hermes (or any content-prep agent) may emit for the Journal content type. One packet = one locale of one Journal entry, always a draft — publication is a human database transition, never a packet field. See content/journal/README.md.

publication_status.description: Deliberately a single-value enum. A packet can never assert 'published' — that is a human database transition (Prompt I §4), not a Hermes field. This is not the same axis as editorial_status.

editorial_status.description: 'clear' = no outstanding concern. 'human_review_pending' = a substantive citation, concept, or scope problem exists and must not be silently repaired.

series.description: 27-Journal-Editorial-Map.md's five series. No department, no Depth Dial — a Journal is not an Issue.

slug.description: Reader-facing only. Never a raw essay filename or source number (27-Journal-Editorial-Map.md — source numbers are internal provenance only).

raw_source.description: A pointer to the immutable source under Assets QP/essays/. Never resolved into public output (README §Reader-facing exposure) — this field itself is stripped from the public read model at the database layer, not just convention.

body_md.description: Original editorial prose only. The 'not' pattern rejects any Arabic-script codepoint outright — a hard, mechanical guard against inline āyah text (protocol hard rule 1), not a style preference. A displayed verse is always rendered from lib/quran.ts by reference (ayah_refs below), never typed here.

translation_edition.description: A named lib/quran.ts API edition, never a translation string. Constrained to editions the codebase actually fetches from (lib/quran.ts ARABIC_EDITION/ENGLISH_EDITION/BANGLA_EDITION) so a packet cannot invent an edition slug.

entry_ordinal.description: Must reference an existing entries[].ordinal — checked by validate.mjs, not expressible in draft-07 JSON Schema alone (no cross-array reference support).

then.description: An observed claim carries no source URL — pairing one would misrepresent a personal observation as sourced fact.

minor_edit_log.description: Append-only. Every automated copy edit, exactly scoped (Prompt I §2.8 / Prompt K §2.4). A publishable body_md whose text differs from raw_source without a matching entry here is not a valid packet state — validate.mjs cross-checks this where practical.

citation_audit_log.description: Append-only. Every factual-claim verification and later source correction (Prompt I §2.9). A verified correction may amend the canonical entry through this trail; nothing here authorizes publication on its own.

approved.description: Never true from Hermes output — approval is the human path. A packet is invalid if this is true (validate.mjs) unless it is literal historical audit provenance being carried forward, which draft packets never contain.
